```scala
private def generateRegex(charMatrix: Array[Array[Long]], distinctDatums: Set[String]): String = {
  if (distinctDatums.size > MAX_DISTINCT_SET) {
    val charSizes = distinctDatums.map(_.trim.length)
    val maxElementSize = charSizes.max
    val minElementSize = charSizes.min

    val regexBuilder = new ListBuffer[String]
    (0 until MAX_CHARS_TO_ANALYZE).foreach {
      charPos =>
        val charArray = charMatrix.map(_(charPos))
        val regexToAdd = getValidChars(charArray) match {
          case Some(".") => Some(".")
          case Some(validChars) =>
            val resultRegex = reduceRegex(validChars)
            if (resultRegex.replaceAllLiterally("\\","").length == 1) Some(resultRegex)
            else Some(s"[$resultRegex]")
          case _ => None
        }
        regexToAdd match {
          case Some(value) =>
            if (charPos >= minElementSize) {
              regexBuilder.append(s"$value?")
            } else {
              regexBuilder.append(value)
            }
          case _ => ()
        }
    }

    if (maxElementSize >= MAX_CHARS_TO_ANALYZE) {
      regexBuilder.append(".*")
    }
    val combinedTokens = combineConsecutiveTokens(regexBuilder).mkString
    "^(?>" + combinedTokens + ")$"
  }
  else distinctDatums.map(escapeRegex).mkString("^(", "|", ")$")
}
```

```scala
/**
  * Generate a regex pattern from a character matrix and a set of distinct datums.
  * If the number of distinct datums is greater than the maximum allowed distinct datums,
  * a regex pattern is generated by analyzing each column of the character matrix and combining the results.
  * Otherwise, the regex pattern is generated by escaping each datum in the set and joining them with "|".
  *
  * @param charMatrix     a two-dimensional array of long values representing characters
  * @param distinctDatums a set of distinct datums to generate a regex pattern from
  * @return a string representing the generated regex pattern
  */
```
